g.text: Commercial source scale: average power matters
Published examples, not a market ceiling | specialist tubes and research shown separately
Source mapping: A:S1 B:S2 C:S3 D:S4 E:S5/S6 F:S7 G/H:S8 I:S9 J:S10 K:S11 L/M/N:S13 O:S14 P:S15.
Bands are nominal family ranges. O: 1 MW peak × 0.002 duty = 2 kW average. P: 18–20 kW average (20 plotted).
